messages:
maya: Heads-up: opened PR to update SDK examples in guides/embedding.md — needs review, esp tone and the new Python snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4723 :raising_hand:

docs-bot: Preview build queued: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.internal/preview/79 (id: 79)

tom: On it. Quick note — preview failed linting. ci-bot reported `mdx-lint` errors.

ci-bot: build 79 failed: mdx-lint errors in guides/embedding.md: line 42, 58. Messages: "heading-style: avoid trailing punctuation", "code-block-language: use explicit language hint". Full logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/79/logs

zane: I also noticed the Python example still uses the older `RedwoodClient(...)` constructor. We standardized on `from redwood import Redwood` + `client = Redwood()` in the SDK reference.

priya: Suggested replacement snippet (py) — short, exact, using new client pattern:
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Translate to French: Hello')
print(resp.text)
```
Keep it minimal; don't show try/catch here so example stays focused.

maya: Good catch. Also question on voice: should this be 2nd-person quickstart tone ("You can call...") or neutral reference ("The client returns...")? Style guide: quickstart = 2nd-person, reference = neutral. This file is borderline.

tom: For embedding guide I'd keep 2nd-person for the step-by-step snippet, but make reference blocks neutral. We'll annotate with a short lead-in sentence to clarify intent. Also I'll remove trailing periods in headings and add explicit `python` fence for the block to satisfy mdx-lint.

ci-bot: build 80 queued (after new commits).

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.internal/preview/80 (id: 80)

zane: LGTM on the snippet. One small nit: add a one-line link to rate limits (internal path: /docs/billing/rate-limits) after the example so teams don't accidentally spam the demo.

maya: I'll add the rate-limits link and push the lint fixes. Will merge after CI goes green. ETA ~20m. :clock1:

priya: Thanks — when you push, please include a short changelog line in the PR body: "Updated SDK snippets to new client API; fixed MDX lint." Helps release notes.

maya: Will do. Thanks everyone! :tada:
